title: THE PAUSE BOX SPEAKS CONTROLLER ON A CONTROLLER
why: Seen on the 4K controller screenshot of 2026-10-08: on a controller (player 2 in co-op) the pause box listed MOUSE aim, LMB fire, WASD move and the rest of the keyboard, keys the pad player does not have. With a pad on it now lists the pad layout (sticks, RT fire, A roll, B crouch, X reload, MENU pause), from the same table as the full controls panel, so the two never disagree.
now: On a controller the pause box lists the controller buttons.

edits.anchor: function keysLegendHtml(){ var n=keyName, s=function(c){ return ''+n(keysOf(c))+''; };

edits.replacement:
pauseOpen=on;
  if(on){ try{ keysLegendApply(); }catch(_pk){} }   // v16.xx: the key line matches the device in hand when the box opens
